name: Set-Theoretic Connectivity Disguise
description: Replaced all graph terminology (connected, path, tree) with a purely set-theoretic definition of a connected component (a set is cohesive if no proper non-empty subset is isolated). I also removed the explicit mention of `m = n - 1` from the text, leaving it only in the formal input bounds. This forces models to logically deduce the tree structure from the partition constraints and input bounds, rather than triggering pre-memorized graph algorithm templates. Models failing to deduce the tree structure will likely misidentify this as an NP-hard general Steiner Tree or ILP problem and fail.
